inset.deleteTitle: Select an inset content group or border to preview deleting the image group, region box and leader lines
inset.deleteSummary: Delete the magnified inset and its region annotation

inset.selectOneImage: Select exactly one image or its semantic anchor.
inset.changedDuringRead: The canvas changed during the read; reopen.
inset.invalidTransform: Invalid image transform; restore the image geometry first.
inset.dragHint: Drag a selection along the image orientation; rotation, mirroring and existing crops stay consistent with the canvas. Percentage coordinates follow the image's own orientation.
inset.regionLabel: Drag to select the magnified region
inset.snapshotNote: Keeps the original file and source, producing a fixed snapshot with a region box and dashed leaders. Later edits or moves of the source image do not refresh the snapshot or region box automatically.
inset.changedReframe: The canvas has changed; cancel and re-select the region.

insetRefresh.title: Check inset source
insetRefresh.revisions: Snapshot source revision: v{{source}}; current canvas: v{{current}}
insetRefresh.sourceMissing: The source image is deleted or missing. The snapshot keeps its content; restore the source image before refreshing.
insetRefresh.geometryChanged: Source image position, transform or crop changed
insetRefresh.syncNote: "Sync region annotation only" keeps the snapshot and title, repositioning the region box and leader lines from the original crop pixels; the original file must be unchanged and the original region must lie within the current crop. It does not follow the source image automatically.
insetRefresh.refreshNote: Keeps the inset's border, title and style, applies the original proportional region to the current source image, and repositions the region box and dashed lines. The image size adapts to the existing border. After replacing the source image, verify the magnified scientific part in the modification.
insetRefresh.discardDetailEdits: Replace the inset's separately edited file or crop with the current source image
insetRefresh.changedDuringCheck: The canvas changed during the check; reopen.
insetRefresh.canvasChangedRecheck: The canvas has changed; recheck the source image.

frameSwap.canvasChangedRetry: The canvas has changed; save and retry.
frameSwap.needTwoFrames: At least two unlocked, unrotated top-level panels are required.
frameSwap.title: Swap panel positions
frameSwap.description: Swaps the positions of two panels and all their content, preserving text, sizes, assets and scientific relations, and reroutes supported cross-panel connectors. Changes appear directly on the canvas and can be undone.
frameSwap.canvasChangedRecheck: The canvas has changed; close the panel and re-verify.
frameSwap.summary: Swap the selected panels' positions and reroute connectors

frameFit.buttonTitle: Tighten the right and bottom padding of all top-level panels to fit their content, keeping a 24-unit margin where possible; content is not moved, the canvas updates directly and can be undone
frameFit.noFrames: There are no top-level panels to tighten.
frameFit.canvasChangedDuringApply: The canvas changed while tightening. The change was kept; save it and verify the revision via "View agent changes".

routing.buttonTitle: Reroute generated cross-panel connectors around obstacles based on their current positions, updating the canvas directly and undoably
routing.noConnectors: There are no cross-panel connectors to reroute.
routing.summary: Reroute cross-panel connectors based on current positions
routing.canvasChangedDuringApply: The canvas changed while rerouting. The change was kept; save it and verify the revision via "View agent changes".

duplicate.selectRange: Select 1 to 100 objects; groups and attached objects expand automatically.
duplicate.title: Duplicate selected components
duplicate.summary: {{count}} objects selected · v{{revision}}. The copy includes owning groups, frame contents, labels and images, expanding up to 1000 objects.
duplicate.note: Internal connections and image ownership point to the copy; un-copied external connections break. The originals stay unchanged. Existing declarations and references are kept; verify they apply to the copy. Annotations, insets and locked members cannot be duplicated here.
duplicate.canvasChangedReselect: The canvas has changed; reselect the components to duplicate.
duplicate.canvasChangedDuringGeneration: The canvas changed during generation; the change was saved, verify the current canvas.

palette.buttonTitle: Select an asset to adjust illustration and label layout; SVGs also support recoloring and internal path editing
palette.canvasChangedSaveFirst: The canvas has changed; save first and retry.
palette.selectOneAsset: Select exactly one SVG, PNG, JPEG or WebP asset (or its semantic anchor).
palette.changedDuringRead: The canvas changed while the palette was read; reopen the palette panel.
palette.vectorNote: Fills, strokes and gradient stops of the same color are replaced together, up to 32 colors per run; text inside the SVG must already be converted to paths. Only this asset instance is modified, not other instances, text marker shapes or layout. Preview the change before applying.
palette.imageNote: Bitmaps keep their original pixels and source; you can adjust the bound illustration's layout, connection scope and labels. Standalone images can use the canvas transform controls directly.
palette.canvasChangedReread: The canvas has changed; cancel and re-read the asset colors.
palette.canvasChangedDuringGeneration: The canvas changed while the color change was generated. The change was kept; save it and verify the revision in the modification list.

illustrationLabels.title: Illustration label layout
illustrationLabels.description: Keeps full label text while adjusting position, wrap width and font size. Only the selected labels change; images and connectors are kept. After editing, check whether the text overlaps other objects.
illustrationLabels.invalid: Enter valid positions, a width of 1–20000 and a font size of 4–200; labels must not exceed 2048 characters.
illustrationLabels.canvasChanged: The canvas has changed; reopen asset edit.

bounds.title: Illustration fit bounds
bounds.description: Drag a box over the original asset to pick the visible content the connector should approach. Only this illustration's semantic anchor and connected endpoints move; the image, crop and scientific evidence are kept. Rotation and mirroring follow the canvas transform; the anchor uses the axis-aligned bounding box of the visible range. The bounds do not represent a biological structure; verify the result on the canvas.
bounds.croppedNote: The gray area is cropped by the canvas; the selection must lie inside the dashed visible region.
bounds.svgLabel: Drag to select the illustration fit bounds
bounds.invalid: Choose a non-empty range within the currently visible area; left plus width and top plus height must not exceed 100%.
bounds.adjustGeometry: Also adjust illustration position and size
bounds.geometryNote: Position uses canvas coordinates, size uses canvas units. The crop, rotation, mirroring and source are preserved and reconnected per the bounds above; label positions are kept separately, verify them among the candidates. The complete rotated image must stay within its panel.
bounds.invalidGeometry: Positions must be valid numbers, width and height must be greater than zero, and no value may exceed 1000000 in absolute terms.
bounds.canvasChanged: The canvas has changed; reopen asset edit and select the range again.
bounds.geometrySummary: Adjust illustration layout and connection bounds

partStyles.canvasChanged: The canvas has changed; reopen asset edit and read the paths again.
partStyles.hint: Indices only identify graphic paths in the current file, not biological components. You can restyle the selected path or translate it in source SVG coordinates. Drag the dot at the center of the orange box to set a translation; preview the change to verify the effect. Upper-level crops and asset boundaries stay in place and overflowing parts are clipped. The opacity factor multiplies the current effect: 1 keeps, 0 hides; hidden paths can be restored from history. Endpoints and curve control points can be read and edited below.
partStyles.contribution: In the {{width}} × {{height}} transparent-background SVG preview, hiding this path changes {{pixels}} pixels. This is not the path area; 0 can result from occlusion, same-color overlap, clipping or tiny structures. Verify the visible effect against the preview.
partStyles.contributionNotComputed: This asset exceeds the per-path comparison limit, so the render contribution was not computed. Rely on the preview.
partStyles.strokeWidthNote: Stroke width is set in local SVG coordinates; canvas zoom and path transforms affect the displayed thickness. Paths without a stroke also need an explicit stroke color. Thickening may enlarge the visible extent or be clipped by the original crop — check the preview.
partStyles.geometryUnsupported: This path's transform cannot be edited, or it contains more than 512 points.

pathPoints.tooManyPoints: At most 64 points can be edited at once; apply the current edits first.
pathPoints.canvasChanged: The canvas has changed; re-read the asset.
pathPoints.changedDuringRead: The canvas changed during the read; re-read the asset.
pathPoints.hint: Orange dots are endpoints, purple dots are curve control points. Pick an index, then drag the dot or enter SVG root coordinates; the orange outline marks the edited contour, verify the effect on the canvas after applying. Only the chosen points move; adjacent curves are not smoothed automatically. Control point edits and whole-path translation must be applied separately.

pathAgent.requestPlaceholder: e.g. change this path to blue and keep everything else
pathAgent.canvasChanged: The canvas has changed; re-read the path before preparing the draft.

pathAgent.previewChanged: The canvas changed while the preview was generated; re-read the path.
pathAgent.agentUnavailableKept: The agent is no longer available; reconnect the illustrator specialist. Your request was kept.

textEdit.canvasChanged: The canvas has changed; reopen text edit.
textEdit.selectRange: Select 1–20 text elements or components with bound text.
textEdit.selectionIncludesOthers: The selection contains objects without bound text; select only text or components with text.
textEdit.unsupportedTextObject: The selection contains unsupported text objects.
textEdit.incompleteBinding: Text {{id}} has an incomplete binding to its container; fix the binding first.

textEdit.containerUnsupported: The container of text {{id}} does not support rewrapping yet.
textEdit.title: Text & wrapping
textEdit.batchNote: Keeps each element's original text, explicit line breaks, font size and current width; shape text is laid out to the container's inner space. Only automatic wrapping is recomputed; check for overlaps afterwards.
textEdit.batchSummaryOperation: Rewrap selected text only, keeping original text and font size
textEdit.boundWrapNote: Wraps to the bound container's available width. If the content is too tall, resize the container or reduce the font size first.
textEdit.styleNote: Font, line height and other styles are preserved. After the change, check wrapping, position and overlaps with other objects.
textEdit.arrowNote: Only the connector label's wrap width is adjusted; arrow geometry and bindings are kept. Check the preview for occlusion of other objects.
textEdit.summaryOperation: Edit the selected text and wrap to the available width
textEdit.fitNote: Tightening the existing box width keeps the current text, wrapping and visible alignment. After changing the inputs above, apply the text change first.
textEdit.cannotFit: Text boxes attached to connectors cannot be tightened directly.
textEdit.fitSummaryOperation: Tighten the selected text box width

captionPathReview.unavailable: Connector caption check is unavailable; verify against the preview.
captionPathReview.description: {{checked}} groups checked, {{skipped}} skipped, and {{omitted}} notices not listed. Text boxes may cover most of a connector; locate and verify, then adjust spacing or routing. This is a bounding-box and path check, not a check of actual glyph occlusion or scientific content.
captionPathReview.coverage: The caption box covers about {{percent}}% of the connector; about {{length}} units of path lie outside the box.

markups.historySuffix: · historical revision, verify against the current canvas

markups.confirmed: I have verified this historical markup against the current v{{revision}} figure
